name: The Last Hope
author: Umarrchh
description:
Storyline: 
Hitomi was living peaceably with her pacifist father, King II. Hitomi was always well tended for by her servants that gave special attention to her needs. But hitomi’s happiness never lasted, she lost everything in just a night, her 16th birthday. Hitomi was forced to exit the castle. All was gone and Hitomi knew it was time to get stronger than she was if she would ever survive. Then began her journey, the journey to kill vampires and their Boss to reclaim her Hometown.
Controls:
Use 'WASD' to move player around in scene. 
Press 'G' to attack Enemies.
